components.name: Chip
components.description: Mushroom chip: icon plus short state, pill, no fill; the icon carries the colour.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--card-background-color, #eff1f5); color: var(--primary-text-color, #4c4f69); font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: #7c7f93; } .ds-chip-icon.ds-on { color: #df8e1d; } .ds-chip:hover { filter: brightness(0.97); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8839ef; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status row
components.description: Bubble button row: 42px icon disc at 20% of the icon colour, name over state, sub-buttons on the right.
components.html: Inside27.6 °C58%On
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px 8px 8px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card-background-color, #eff1f5); color: var(--primary-text-color, #4c4f69); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-disc { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; color: #7c7f93; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent); } .ds-disc.ds-on { color: #8839ef; } .ds-disc svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; } .ds-row-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; } .ds-row-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-row-state { font-size: 12px; color: #5c5f77; } .ds-sub { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(76, 79, 105, 0.05); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-sub-on { background: rgba(136, 57, 239, 0.2); color: #8839ef; } .ds-sub:hover { filter: brightness(0.97); }

components.name: Sub-button
components.description: Bubble sub-button / Mushroom control: 12px corners, text-at-5% idle, primary-at-20% when on with solid primary icon.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(76, 79, 105, 0.05); color: #4c4f69; font: 600 13px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-on { background: rgba(136, 57, 239, 0.2); color: #8839ef; } .ds-btn:hover { background: rgba(76, 79, 105, 0.09); } .ds-btn-on:hover { background: rgba(136, 57, 239, 0.28); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8839ef; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Device tile
components.description: Vertical Mushroom-style tile used in room cards: disc, name, state.
components.html: FanOff
components.css: .ds-tile { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 14px 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #4c4f69; } .ds-tile-disc { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; color: #7c7f93; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent); } .ds-tile-disc svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; } .ds-tile-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tile-state { font-size: 12px; color: #5c5f77; }

components.name: Navigation bar
components.description: Floating navbar: card colour with blur, card radius, icon-only; the active icon is solid mauve with no fill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(239, 241, 245, 0.94); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 64px; height: 52px; border-radius: 12px; color: #7c7f93; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { color: #8839ef; background: transparent; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #4c4f69; }

components.name: Section separator
components.description: Bubble separator used for every section title: label plus a faint rule.
components.css: .ds-sep { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 18px 8px 6px; font: 600 17px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #4c4f69; } .ds-sep i { flex: 1; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(76, 79, 105, 0.08); }

narrative.overview:
A phone dashboard for one household, read at a glance and worked with one thumb. It is an Operate surface: every view starts with a row of status chips, then the cards you act on. Nothing announces itself. State is carried by colour on an icon and a short line of text, and the only strong colour on a screen is the one that means something is on.

The visual language is borrowed, deliberately, from two stock card libraries. Bubble Card provides the status rows, sub-buttons, pop-ups and section separators; Mushroom provides climate, fan, light, entity, person, media and chip cards. Hand-built button-card templates survive only where no stock card fits, and they are styled to be indistinguishable from Mushroom. The theme is Catppuccin, Latte in light mode and Mocha in dark.
keyCharacteristics: One font (Inter), one card colour, one page colour, one idle grey.
Icon discs and active fills are always the icon's own colour at 20%.
Chips first on every view; no page titles; sections named by Bubble separators.
Tap acts, hold opens the dialog, and status-only things open their dialog on tap.
Sentence case, middle-dot separators, short relative times.

rules.name: The Twenty Percent Rule
rules.body: A disc or active fill is never a new colour. It is the icon's colour at 20% opacity. Idle discs are the idle grey at 20%; idle sub-buttons are the text colour at 5%.

rules.name: The Sensor Is Never On Rule
rules.body: A sensor reading gets no fill behind its sub-button or chip. Fills mean a switchable thing is switched on.

rules.name: The Three-to-One Rule
rules.body: Every icon colour reaches 3:1 on the card background in both modes; the cat accent is the one recorded exception.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Copy follows Home Assistant: "Lunch tomorrow 12:00", "All off", "Schedule off". Never title case for a state.

rules.name: The Middle Dot Rule
rules.body: Compound states join with " · ". Episode details join with " • ".

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. If a surface needs separation, change its tone, not its elevation.

dos: Do reach for Bubble Card or Mushroom first; add a button-card template only when no stock card can do the job.
Do start every view with the chip row and let the Home Assistant header be the title.
Do derive every disc and active fill from the icon colour at 20%, and keep sensors unfilled.
Do use the entity's default icon; override only when the icon encodes state (aircon mode, lock).
Do keep Devices sections to controls, grouped by type, and merge adjacent grids so columns fill.
Do give every control a tap and a hold: tap acts, hold opens the dialog; dangerous actions confirm first.
Do write states in sentence case with " · " between parts, and show "—" rather than NaN or 0.0 when a sensor is unavailable.
Do verify in the browser after a theme change, reload themes for theme edits, and touch ui-lovelace.yaml for dashboard edits.
donts: Don't fill the active navbar item or show navbar labels; the navbar is the one exception to the control styling.
Don't paint a sub-button solid; the solid colour goes on the icon and text, the fill stays at 20%.
Don't use Bubble's horizontal-buttons-stack for inline rows; it is a fixed footer.
Don't add an entry animation to all cards via card-mod; it re-fires on every state update.
Don't repeat an entity on a page, put a page title above the chips, or put status rows in a Devices section.
Don't show more than one decimal on a temperature, or a unit on a chip when the degree sign will do.
Don't rely on colour alone for on/off where the icon is identical; add the state word.
